```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

movies_file <- "movies.dat"
ratings_file <- "ratings.dat"
users_file <- "users.dat"

read_movielens <- function(file, n_fields) {
  lines <- readLines(file, warn = FALSE)
  data <- str_split_fixed(lines, "::", n_fields)
  as.data.frame(data, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

movies <- read_movielens(movies_file, 3)
ratings <- read_movielens(ratings_file, 4)
users <- read_movielens(users_file, 5)

colnames(movies) <- c("MovieID", "Title", "Genres")
colnames(ratings) <- c("UserID", "MovieID", "Rating", "Timestamp")
colnames(users) <- c("UserID", "Gender", "Age", "Occupation", "ZipCode")

movies$MovieID <- as.integer(movies$MovieID)
ratings$UserID <- as.integer(ratings$UserID)
ratings$MovieID <- as.integer(ratings$MovieID)
ratings$Rating <- as.numeric(ratings$Rating)
ratings$Timestamp <- as.numeric(ratings$Timestamp)
users$UserID <- as.integer(users$UserID)

# converting timestamp to readable date
ratings$Date <- as.POSIXct(ratings$Timestamp, origin = "1970-01-01")

# Merging datasets 
movie_ratings <- merge(ratings, movies, by = "MovieID")

cat("Movies:", nrow(movies), "\n")
cat("Ratings:", nrow(ratings), "\n")
cat("Users:", nrow(users), "\n")

```

## Part A 





"Popularity" definition: based on average rating among movies with at least 1250 user ratings 

```{r}
movie_summary <- movie_ratings %>%
  group_by(MovieID, Title) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_rating = mean(Rating),
    num_ratings = n()
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Top 10 Highest Rated (with >= 1250 ratings)
top_highest_rated <- movie_summary %>%
  filter(num_ratings >= 1250) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_rating)) %>%
  head(10)

cat("\nTop 10 Highest Rated Movies :\n")
print(top_highest_rated)

```


## B 

```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)

R_dense <- ratings %>%
  select(UserID, MovieID, Rating) %>%
  mutate(UserID = as.integer(UserID),
         MovieID = as.integer(MovieID)) %>%
  arrange(UserID, MovieID) %>%
  pivot_wider( names_from = MovieID,values_from = Rating,values_fill = NA_real_
  ) %>%
  arrange(UserID)

user_ids <- R_dense$UserID
R_dense <- R_dense %>% remove_rownames() %>% column_to_rownames("UserID")
R_dense <- as.matrix(R_dense)

row_means <- rowMeans(R_dense, na.rm = TRUE)  
R_centered_dense <- sweep(R_dense, 1, row_means,
  FUN = function(x, m) ifelse(is.na(x), NA_real_, x - m)
)

movie_ids <- as.integer(colnames(R_dense))
cat("\nCentered rating matrix dimensions:\n")
dim(R_centered_dense)    
```

## 2. 

```{r}
library(Matrix)

R_filled <- R_centered_dense
R_filled[is.na(R_filled)] <- 0
R_sparse <- Matrix(R_filled, sparse = TRUE)

co_counts <- as.matrix((t(!is.na(R_centered_dense)) %*% (!is.na(R_centered_dense))))
num <- as.matrix(t(R_sparse) %*% R_sparse)
norms <- sqrt(colSums(R_sparse^2))
denom <- outer(norms, norms)
cosine_raw <- num / denom

cosine_raw[co_counts < 3] <- NA
cosine_sim <- (1 + cosine_raw) / 2
diag(cosine_sim) <- 1

cat("\nSimilarity matrix dimensions:", dim(cosine_sim), "\n")

cat("\nSimilarity Matrix ")
print(cosine_sim[1:5, 1:5])  
```

## 3. 
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringdist)

keep_top_k <- function(sim_matrix, k = 30) {
  n <- nrow(sim_matrix)
  sim_filtered <- matrix(NA_real_, n, n, dimnames = dimnames(sim_matrix))
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    sims <- sim_matrix[i, ]
    sims[i] <- NA
    valid_idx <- which(!is.na(sims))
    if (length(valid_idx) > k) {
      top_k <- order(sims[valid_idx], decreasing = TRUE)[1:k]
      keep_idx <- valid_idx[top_k]
    } else {
      keep_idx <- valid_idx
    }
    sim_filtered[i, keep_idx] <- sims[keep_idx]
  }
  
  sim_filtered <- pmax(sim_filtered, t(sim_filtered), na.rm = TRUE)
  diag(sim_filtered) <- 1
  return(sim_filtered)
}

cosine_top30 <- keep_top_k(cosine_sim, k = 30)
movie_lookup <- movies %>%
  mutate(MovieID = as.character(MovieID),
    Title = iconv(Title, from = "", to = "UTF-8")
  )

target_titles <- c("Toy Story (1995)","GoldenEye (1995)","Liar Liar (1997)","Lost World: Jurassic Park (1997)","Sixth Sense, The (1999)")
target_titles <- iconv(target_titles, from = "", to = "UTF-8")
matched_movie_ids <- sapply(target_titles, function(t) {
  movie_lookup$MovieID[
    which.min(stringdist(t, movie_lookup$Title, method = "jw"))
  ]
})

names(matched_movie_ids) <- target_titles

cat("\n TOP-30 filtered pairwise similarity values \n\n")

for (i in seq_along(matched_movie_ids)) {
  movie_id <- matched_movie_ids[i]
  movie_title <- names(matched_movie_ids)[i]
  sims <- cosine_top30[movie_id, ]
  sims_non_na <- sims[!is.na(sims) & names(sims) != movie_id]
  cat(movie_title, ":\n")
  print(sims_non_na)
  cat("\n")
}

```



## 4. 
```{r}
IBCF_recommend <- function(newuser,sim_matrix,movie_summary,top_n = 10,
                           popularity_ranking_file = "movie_popularity.csv") {

  if (length(newuser) != ncol(sim_matrix))
    stop("")

  user_mean <- mean(newuser, na.rm = TRUE)
  centered_user <- newuser - user_mean
  rated_idx   <- which(!is.na(centered_user))
  unrated_idx <- which(is.na(centered_user))
  preds <- rep(NA_real_, length(newuser))

  for (j in unrated_idx) {
    sims <- sim_matrix[j, rated_idx]
    ratings <- centered_user[rated_idx]
    valid <- !is.na(sims)
    if (sum(valid) >= 1) {
      num <- sum(sims[valid] * ratings[valid], na.rm = TRUE)
      denom <- sum(abs(sims[valid]), na.rm = TRUE)
      if (denom > 0) {
        preds[j] <- user_mean + (num / denom) 
      }
    }
  }

  names(preds) <- colnames(sim_matrix)
  pred_df <- data.frame(Title = names(preds),PredictedRating = preds
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(PredictedRating)) %>%arrange(desc(PredictedRating))

  if (file.exists(popularity_ranking_file)) {
    pop_rank <- read.csv(popularity_ranking_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  } else {
    pop_rank <- movie_summary %>%
      arrange(desc(num_ratings), desc(avg_rating)) %>%
      select(Title)
    write.csv(pop_rank, popularity_ranking_file, row.names = FALSE)
  }

  already_rated_titles <- names(newuser)[which(!is.na(newuser))]

  if (nrow(pred_df) < top_n) {
    needed <- top_n - nrow(pred_df)
    fillers <- pop_rank %>%
      filter(!(Title %in% pred_df$Title),
             !(Title %in% already_rated_titles)) %>%
      slice_head(n = needed) %>%
      mutate(PredictedRating = NA)
    pred_df <- bind_rows(pred_df, fillers)
  }

  top_recs <- pred_df %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n)

  return(top_recs)
}

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringdist)

user1500 <- R_dense[1500, ]
names(user1500) <- colnames(R_dense)

cat("\nTop 10 Recommendations for Existing User (row 1500)\n")

rec_user1500 <- IBCF_recommend(
  newuser        = user1500,
  sim_matrix     = cosine_top30,
  movie_summary  = movie_summary,
  top_n          = 10
)

print(rec_user1500)

```
